evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 2.97→3.09→3.13→3.23 Torr vs ~2.99±0.02 held through ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow-setpoint change
Temperature holds 750 °C with normal heater power ~44%
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak status cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or equivalent leak check) to separate a seal leak from a downstream exhaust restriction; a pump-down/flow-step test watching pressure response would also discriminate.
